maddeler.e:
تحتوون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَوُونَ (taḥtawūna) /taħ.ta.wuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
# تُحْتَوَوْنَ (tuḥtawawna) /tuħ.ta.waw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَوَى (iḥtawā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
